annotations.limits: disclosed MW is populated on a minority of facility rows, so a facility count is a PRESENCE signal and not a capacity one — metered_facility_count reports the share that carries MW · no per-rack power density is ingested; there is no public source

description: Use this when the user wants a 0-100 grade for one existing data center facility across 7 dimensions — power, fiber, water, climate_risk, tax_environment, talent_pool, expansion. Example: "How does the CoreWeave Las Vegas site score, power-weighted?" — score_facility facility_id=<id> weighting=power_priority. Params: facility_id or name (required); weighting one of "balanced" (default) | "power_priority" | "risk_priority" | "expansion_priority". Returns: composite 0-100, tier_classification, peer comparison, and per-dimension detail. Do NOT use for a raw lat/lon parcel (use analyze_site), to compare 2 or more sites (use compare_sites), or to find similar sites (use find_alternatives).

facility_id.description: The facility id/slug to score (required), from a prior search_facilities result
